I am a man of 52 years in North Central Nigeria, farming this small maize plot near my house. I did not go to school, but I have farmed maize since I was a boy, and I know what works on my land. The rains are coming, so I will plant with the first good rain. I cannot afford too much, but I will buy some fertilizer because without it the maize will not give good cobs on this tired soil. I will put the chicken and goat droppings from my compound on the plot too, and my wife and children will help me weed. For this small plot I don't need many hired hands, only maybe for clearing and first weeding when the grass is strong.
